verdict.rationale: Fellow's own marketing claims admins can set organization-wide policies for how meetings are accessed, and that the team keeps control over what they share. That is a direct but very thin claim about sharing governance, with no detail behind it. MCP connection governance and the Super Admin data-export API belong to other stories and are not credited here. Missing for 10: documented private-by-default notes, granular link/folder/workspace permission settings, admin visibility or reporting on what is shared, in-depth help docs, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, sharing is controlled — private-by-default notes, granular link/folder/workspace permissions, and admin visibility into what's shared
